def factor_drawdown_ewm(df):
    """Ewm drawdown duration: fraction of days within ewm lookback where close is below its 120-day rolling high, inverted so that stocks with fewer drawdown days are preferred."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    high = df_copy["high"]
    lookback_peak = 120
    lookback_ewm_span = 20
    peak_hist = high.rolling(lookback_peak, min_periods=lookback_peak).max().shift(1)
    peak_hist = peak_hist.fillna(method="ffill")
    in_drawdown = (close < peak_hist).astype(int)
    drawdown_ratio = in_drawdown.ewm(span=lookback_ewm_span, min_periods=lookback_ewm_span).mean()
    drawdown_signal = -drawdown_ratio
    df_copy["factor_drawdown_ewm"] = drawdown_signal
    return df_copy["factor_drawdown_ewm"]
description: Mutates the parent by ablating the volume intensity modifier, simplifying back to a pure ewm drawdown duration factor. The core mechanism remains stocks with fewer recent drawdown days are preferred. Simplification may reduce noise and improve robustness while preserving the drawdown economic intuition.
